visualFindings.result: The NFL screen uses the same 393/430 phone-shell dimensions as Home, with an internal vertical scroller and a fixed bottom navigation. It does not expand into an oversized dashboard when entering NFL.

Diamond PROJECT, gold DOLLAR and emerald bag branding are sharp and unclipped. The genuine local NFL shield sits in an illuminated circular medallion beside readable season context and the functional week selector.

Three primary tabs and AFC/NFC controls preserve the approved hierarchy. The dense standings align rank, team, W/L, PCT, points, differential and recent-form cells. Steelers have a clear inline metrics/detail strip. Real source ordering is retained rather than reproducing illustrative reference ranks.

Facing helmet artwork, genuine independent team marks, blue stadium light, crystalline edge accents, VS and three inline actions reproduce the approved matchup structure. Generated helmet equipment is decorative artwork, not claimed official photography or athlete imagery.
Stacked QB/RB/WR panels retain native aligned text and five visible leaders per panel; View all expands the sourced lists inline. Every fifth-row rank/TD is visibly clear in the actual screenshots.

Dark opaque fills, substantial cyan/gold faceted rails, crisp local condensed fonts, fixed star glints and continuous native edge/stadium lighting materially improve the rejected drafts. Glow does not wash across factual table text.

The small black patch/white arc observed in untouched native first paint was a reproducible rounded-overflow defect. The narrowly scoped opaque Page 2 mask removes it in the current fresh first-paint and settled originals at both sizes.
